description: Send a booking / staffing request, including the requester's name, email, and optional phone, to a Soundcheck organization, which creates a lead its team follows up on. Requires organization_id, name, email, event_date, event_type, and location. User confirmation: nothing is sent until the person confirms by email: the call only emails a confirmation link to the address given, and the request reaches the organization after that person opens the email and clicks Confirm.

event_type.description: the kind of event (e.g. wedding, festival, corporate, concert)

location.description: where the event is (city / venue / address)

message.description: what the requester needs (roles, headcount, details)

organization_id.description: the Soundcheck organization to send this booking/staffing request to (slug or id)

name: request_booking

data.description: tool payload (API/composite/confirmation object); object, array, or primitive JSON

title: Request booking
